newsitem.title: ITALY: Snia group in spotlight on Milan bourse.
newsitem.headline: Snia group in spotlight on Milan bourse.

text.p: Fiat group units Snia Bpd and Sorin Biomedica were under the spotlight on the Milan stockmarket for the second day on Tuesday with some analysts seeing a revival of talk Fiat might be wanting to restructure its chemical division.
Both stocks were suspended limit up on Monday when they touched a 10 percent permitted ceiling in brisk trade.
Sorin heads up the bio-engineering activities of chemical holding Snia Bpd.
There was no immediate comment from Fiat, but analysts said the two stocks were being driven up by talk of a possible reorganisation of Fiat's chemical units.
"These are rumours which emerge regularly. It is clear that Fiat must find a new (asset) allocation for Snia Bpd," said Claudia Vignati, analyst at Credito Italiano.
